ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Corporate training, Enquiry qualified and later stages need Training need and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Corporate_training", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry qualified", 1, "Needs analysis", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Stakeholder review", 4, "Terms agreed", 5, "Booked", 6, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Training_need__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Training need and Next step date before moving to Enquiry qualified.
